evidence: Full recursive listing of the frozen task (43 files, 18 directories) compared against the closed list in staged-task-contract.md. Required files all present and non-empty: instruction.md, task.toml, environment/Dockerfile, environment/instructions/{behaviour,integration,overview,policy,security,ui}.md, environment/assets/seed_data.json, solution/solve.sh, solution/app/server.js, tests/{Dockerfile,test.sh,scoring.toml,app_context.md,.dockerignore}, tests/gates/{render,constraints}/{judge.toml,prompt.md}, tests/scored/{functional,polish,visual}/{judge.toml,prompt.md}, tests/tools/{score.py,restart_mcp.py}. Nothing outside the list: tests/ holds exactly the listed entries (no reward.toml, no coverage.json, no extra entry); no NOTES.md/SOLUTION.md, .env, zip, spreadsheet, saved runs, node_modules, *.db/-wal/-shm, __pycache__, *.bak/*.orig/*~/*.log/*.map, .DS_Store/Thumbs.db; no empty directories, zero-byte files or symlinks; the only dotfile is tests/.dockerignore, byte-identical to the frozen template's. environment/assets/seed_data.json is on the contract's closed list (and the skill says a seed flag is at most a Note). Residue probe on solution/app/**: solution/app/public/{index.html,runner.html,assets/index.js,assets/index.css} is Vite output (vite.config.mjs outDir 'public'), and public/runner.html and public/assets/index.css are byte-identical to static/runner.html and src/style.css. This is not build residue: server.js:130-131 serves only public/, solve.sh line 'cp -a "$source_app/." /app/' installs without any build step, and integration.md:5 requires 'opening the finished app must not require an install or build step', so the committed bundle is the runtime payload and removing it would break the golden. The bundle carries no sourceMappingURL and no host/user path strings. src/, static/, index.html, tsconfig.json, vite.config.mjs, package.json and package-lock.json are the bundle's sources, inside the solution/app/** wildcard. The live projects/colderwater-playground-devtools file tree is identical in file set to the frozen snapshot. Adversarial tries: (a) stray-file case - looked for a committed cache or backup hidden under solution/app or tests and found none; (b) over-strict case - treating the prebuilt public/ bundle or seed_data.json as stray would fail a conforming task, which the contract's app/** wildcard and the skill's known-false-positive note rule out. Limitation: this is a manual tree comparison; the private check-required-files.py checker was not run, so no claim is made about its output.
